g.text: Who we are, what we stand for and where we came from: the
identity of the College of Information and Computer Studies, DLSU-D.
The College of Information and Computer Studies (CICS) is the
computing college of De La Salle University-Dasmariñas,
committed to academic excellence, innovation and ethical
The college brings students, faculty and industry partners together in an
inclusive environment to work on complex technological problems. It runs
two departments, Computer Science and Information Technology, and
offers the BS Computer Science and BS Information Technology programs.
CICS aims to prepare future leaders who excel in their professions and
contribute meaningfully to the global digital landscape.
